tagline: Your local STIHL dealer and service workshop
heroSubheading: Equipment, parts, servicing, and advice from your local STIHL dealer.
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Rangiora, your local dealer stocking the full range of STIHL outdoor power equipment. Whether you're a contractor, farmer, or homeowner, we have what you need. From chainsaws and hedge trimmers to lawnmowers and brushcutters, we stock the lot.

We service and repair STIHL equipment in our workshop. Bring yours in for maintenance, repairs, or a checkup, and we'll get you back up and running properly. We stock genuine STIHL parts and can advise you on what you need for your job or property. We're here to keep your equipment working.

We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5:30pm, Saturday 9:30am to 3pm, and Sunday 10am to 3pm. Pop in and see what we have.
servicesIntro: We service and repair STIHL equipment in our workshop.
